questions.question: What is AQL?
questions.answer: AQL stands for Acceptable Quality Level, a statistical measure used in quality control to determine acceptable defect rates.AQL defines the maximum number of defective items allowed in a sample size.For example, an AQL of 1.5% means that in a sample of 1000 items, up to 15 defects are acceptable.It is commonly used in manufacturing and inspection processes to ensure product quality.Different industries may have varying AQL standards based on product type and risk factors.
